camel_example: aliyun iot UpdateSpeech --region cn-hangzhou --SpeechCode VlKzbj3XIZ0000CeIHH6vR82JNCSzk00 --ProjectCode 4de2c36700008c585e599200 --Voice Siyue
description_en: Updates a speech corpus, including the broadcast voice, broadcast speed, and volume
description_zh: 更新语料，包括语料的播报声音、播报速度和音量大小等
kebab_example: aliyun iot update-speech --voice Siyue --speech-code VlKzbj3XIZ0000CeIHH6vR82JNCSzk00 --project-code 4de2c36700008c585e599200 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateSpeech

parameters.help_en: The broadcast voice of the speech corpus. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/217887.html to query available voice types. Set this parameter to the Value in VoiceList of the response
parameters.help_zh: 更新创建语料时设置的语料播报声音，可以选择的声音类型通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/217887.html进行查询，填入返回参数中**VoiceList**中**Value**的值
parameters.name: voice

parameters.help_en: The ID of the speech corpus. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/217576.html to query the ID
parameters.help_zh: 语料ID，该参数可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/217576.html查询
parameters.name: speech_code

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If an ID value is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If the Overview page or ID value is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无实例概览页面或ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The broadcast speed. Default value: 0. Valid values: -500 to 500
parameters.help_zh: 播报速度，默认值为0，取值范围：-500~500
parameters.name: speech_rate

parameters.help_en: The volume. Default value: 50. Valid values: 0 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 音量大小，默认值为50，取值范围：0~100
parameters.name: volume

parameters.help_en: The project ID, which is the unique identifier of the project. You can obtain the project ID from the Project Management console (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/things-service/projects)
parameters.help_zh: 项目ID，是项目的唯一标识，您可以通过项目管理控制台 (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/things-service/projects)获取项目ID
parameters.name: project_code

parameters.help_en:
The sound code configuration. This parameter contains the following fields:


SoundCodeContent: the marketing content of the sound code, such as the URL of product details.

AdditionalDuration: the duration for which the sound code is played after the speech corpus playback ends. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 1 to 15
parameters.help_zh:
声码配置，包含字段如下：


SoundCodeContent：声码营销内容，例如商品的详情地址等。

AdditionalDuration：语料播放结束后的声码播放时长，单位为秒，取值范围为1～15
parameters.name: sound_code_config

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the sound code.

<notice> If you set this parameter to true, you must specify the SoundCodeConfig parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
是否启用声码。

<notice> 如果传入了true，必须传入参数SoundCodeConfig，否则调用会失败。
</notice>
parameters.name: enable_sound_code

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误信息
ErrorMessage.example: 千里传音解决方案未开通

RequestId.description_en: The request ID generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call is successful.

true: The call is successful.

false: The call fails
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。

true：调用成功。

false：调用失败
